'''2005 New York State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship in New York (9 July 2005).<ref name="pc-events05">[https://web.archive.org/web/20050828001521/http://swccgpc.com:80/events.htm 2004/2005 Events: SWCCG 2005 Worlds Qualifiers Listing (updated 27 June 2005)], swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 28 August 2005.</ref> It is known from the decklists below, recovered from DeckTech posts and Players Committee forms.

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' New York
* '''Dates:''' 9 July 2005<ref name="pc-events05" />
* '''Day 2 bye:''' [[Justin Roth]]<ref name="pc-events05" />

The Players Committee's 2005 Worlds qualifier listing gives the New York State Championship bye to [[Justin Roth]], while the published decklists record [[Scott Lingrell]] as the winner. Lingrell already held a Day 2 bye from the Neutral Ground Open Qualifier of 8 January 2005, and the Committee passed a bye down to the next finisher in that case, as it did at the 2005 Tennessee States.<ref name="pc-events05" /><ref name="pcf-5728">[https://web.archive.org/web/20050802104132/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=5728 Tennessee States July 16th....], Micah Wooten and Royce Russell (31 May – 19 July 2005), Player's Committee Forums, swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 2 August 2005.</ref>
